question: After the posture servos are released, does the closed hair-plate -> CNS -> coxa loop on the CONDITIONAL channels joint_LFCoxa and joint_LHCoxa change how or how fast the body rolls over, compared with a matched control that keeps the same two servos without neural input?
known_before_registration: Step C R_OFF/R_ON and V1.2 R arms all roll over (~150 deg mean). Coxa admission V1 (CONFIRMED in held posture). A 5100-step plumbing smoke (R22_2, K_2, KC_2) verified the release events and inventories only; its output is discarded. No arm of this protocol has run past the smoke.

sources.assistance_native: partition/model_record/neutral_record/write_rows unchanged; the 20-row variant lives in the new module

candidates.label: COXA_CONDITIONAL_H1
candidates.hash_rule: sha256 of json.dumps(native(defs), sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) of the two channels from coxa_hypothesis_loop.definitions(<D2 arm>, D2 channels)

R22.rule: assistance authority selected rows (22), gain and bias zeroed (Step C)

K.rule: the same 22 rows minus the kept coordinates; kept rows keep their original gain and bias; after-record must equal the expected neutral record exactly

seeds.mechanism: as coxa admission V1: attach requires time 0, zero spikes and a fresh default_rng(1) state, then brain.rng = default_rng(seed)

arms.R22_s: Step C R_ON release, no coxa channel

integrity.I2: within each seed identical schedule and per-tick uniforms_sha256 across the four arms
integrity.I3: R22_1 equals saved Step C R_ON in fired, uniforms_sha256, hair_delivered and qpos
integrity.I4: every event at state 5005 with its declared operation; after_sha256 == neutral_sha256; released ids equal the declared list; kept coordinates as declared; one neutral sha per group (R22 vs K-type), and the two differ
integrity.I5: v3 channel inventories identical to K_1 in every arm; R22/K have no hypothesis channel and never change commands 0 or 14; KC/KF have exactly the two candidates with the preregistered definition hash and label; other non-v3 commands equal K_s; |offset| <= 0.25 rad
integrity.I6: within each seed R22 equals K in qpos and commands for samples 0..5005 and in fired up to the event time; KC/KF equal K before their first candidate command
integrity.I7: tick-1 uniforms of K_1..K_3 pairwise different; every arm records its seed

measures.T_roll: time (ms) of the first sample after state 5005 with world tilt (hair_plate_posture.tilt_deg) > 90 deg; none -> 2000 ms, reported censored
measures.tilt: window mean/peak tilt and rollover samples
measures.descriptive: body z axis at T_roll; candidate offsets after release (mean, max, near-bound fraction); LF/LH forward component; hair rates; coxa MN rates per leg; first physical divergence from K_s

Q_SIGN.evaluated: only if Q_NEURAL is LOOP_DELAYS or LOOP_HASTENS; else NOT_EVALUATED
Q_SIGN.SIGN_SPECIFIC: T_roll(KF_s) - T_roll(K_s) fails the same >= 20 ms same-direction test in at least 2 of 3 seeds

Q_RESCUE.RESCUE: KC has no post-release sample with tilt > 90 deg in any seed and K has one in every seed

labels.bar: 20 ms = 200 physics samples = 40 neural ticks; not tied to an expected outcome

predictions: Recorded in the design doc: NO_RESCUE; NO_CONSISTENT_ASSIST_EFFECT likely; NO_CONSISTENT_LOOP_EFFECT (low confidence, exploratory).
interpretation_limits: Partial release: the 20 v3 position servos remain; not independent balance or gait.
Offset-on-servo actuation; K adds position assistance at two joints by design and is the matched control.
Three seeds vary only stochastic sensory timing.
Channels are CONDITIONAL (COXA_CONDITIONAL_H1), not admitted; 20/42 admitted, +2 conditional.
single_run: Executed once after protocol, code and tests are committed; no reruns, no rule changes.
